messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning a narrow prod cutover tonight at 22:00 UTC (30m window). Services in scope: API, runtime, console, router. Proposing sequence: router -> runtime -> api -> console. Any objections?
liam: router first makes sense if we can warm new routes. Concern about sticky sessions — need short drain on old router before traffic flip. :eyes:
marta: Agree with sequence. We should hedge runtime version: primary v3.0.0 with v2.x fallback pinned in routing table. API needs to accept both model tags during transition.
anya: I'll run preflight smoke for each service. Can you add explicit canary slices in the plan? I want automated health gates.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: wave=prod-cutover-2026-03-22_22:00 UTC, canary=5% (10m), full rollout=20m, rollback-window=30m. Trigger: manual confirm.
sam: Thanks. Proposed health gates (thresholds): 95th latency <200ms, error rate <0.5% (5xx combined), request success p95 >= 99%. If canary fails, automatic rollback to previous variant.
liam: Add metrics check for KV cache evictions on runtime — I've seen spikes when sequence changes. If eviction rate >1% of ops, pause.
marta: Release note items I'll add: runtime v3.0.0 (kernel batching optimizations), API v2.5.3 (dual-tag acceptance), router routing-table:v2 (version hedging), console feature flag show-v3. Include instructions for support to pin customers to old variant.
sam: Rollout plan (copy to thread):
```
1) Router: rollout routing-table:v2 to 5% canary (warm new routes, 2-min warm).
2) Runtime: deploy v3.0.0 to canary nodes, KV cache off for canary.
3) API: deploy v2.5.3 with accept-tags=v3,v2, set short timeout.
4) Console: enable show-v3 feature flag in staging, then prod after runtime steady.
5) Traffic shift to 100% over 20m if gates pass.
```
anya: I'll execute the smoke test checklist after each step: basic gen, long-seq perf, embed sanity, trace sampling. Will post results in thread.
liam: Manual rollback command we agreed on in runbook: `deploy rollback --service runtime --to v2.9.8 --reason "cutover health gate"` — ops-escalate if rollback initiated.
marta: Also add a pinned note in console release panel explaining temporary dual-accept behavior for API consumers (tagging clients).
ops-bot: Reminder: change window annotation created in calendar: PROD-CUTOVER-2026-03-22 22:00-22:30 UTC. Pager schedule: liam on-call 22:00-23:00.
sam: One more: can we mute noisy alerts for 10m during the traffic shift to avoid alert fatigue? We'll only keep high-sev SLO alerts.
liam: I'll mute non-critical alerts, keep SLO and infra alerts.
marta: I'm updating release notes & support playbook now. I'll paste support quick-steps here once done.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks required. Waiting on manual `deploy confirm prod-cutover-2026-03-22` from @sam or @liam to start canary.
sam: I'll issue confirm at 21:55 UTC after final checklist. I'll be on the thread and reachable on phone. Ping @anya to start smoke timer when canary begins.
liam: Sounds good. Any last concerns?
anya: None from infra side. Will run the smoke steps and post timestamps.
sam: Great — see you at 21:55. Final note: if any service shows regression > our rollforward thresholds, abort and run rollback command. Keep notes minimal and clear in incident doc. :thumbsup:
